author: PBS Space Time
description:
Zoom out far enough, and the universe reveals an enormous cosmic web of galaxies, filaments, and vast empty voids. Discover how tiny quantum fluctuations in the early universe grew under the influence of gravity into the largest structures in the cosmos.
